title: ProviderInfo
description: AI model provider metadata aggregating models and configuration. Providers expose collections of models with specific configurations, authentication requirements, and API endpoints.

key.description: Partial/masked API key hint (for display purposes)

models.description: Curated models for this provider (configured/enabled models only, not all discoverable models)

x-design-notes.curated-models: models field contains only curated models (configured/enabled), not all discoverable models
